mismatches.say: Let's say his policy is on the twenty thirteen I S O businessowners form. I S O's revised forms apply to Michigan policies written on or after July first, twenty twenty-five, so newer policies may differ. Businessowners questions are six percent of your exam, about nine items.
mismatches.heard: Let's say his policy is on the 2013 ISO Business Owners Form. ISO's revised forms apply to Michigan policies written on or after July 1, 2025, so newer policies may differ. Business owners' questions are 6% of your exam, about 9 items.

mismatches.say: Dana's pick: a businessowners policy, or B O P. It packages property and liability for small-to-medium businesses.
mismatches.heard: Dana's Pick, a business owners policy, or BOP. It packages property and liability for small to medium businesses.

mismatches.say: Fixed that afternoon, and the insurer knows.

mismatches.say: The B O P has no coinsurance clause. Insure to at least eighty percent of replacement cost, and losses are paid at replacement cost.
mismatches.heard: The BOP has no co-insurance clause. Ensure to at least 80% of replacement cost and losses are paid at replacement cost.

mismatches.say: Two sixties: ordinary payroll gets sixty days, and Extended Business Income up to sixty days after reopening, unless more are shown.
mismatches.heard: To 60s, ordinary payroll gets 60 days and extended business income up to 60 days after reopening, unless more are shown.

mismatches.say: Professional services, like accounting, are excluded. And for drivers' own cars on the job, Tony adds Hired and Non-Owned Auto Liability.
mismatches.heard: Professional services, like accounting, are excluded. And for drivers' own cars on the job, Tony adds hired and non-owned auto liability.

mismatches.say: Last, Section three: common policy conditions, like the rules for canceling. A cancellation notice is the written warning an insurer must mail before it cancels your policy.
mismatches.heard: Last, Section 3, Common Policy Conditions, like the Rules for Cancelling. A cancellation notice is the written warning an insurer must mail before it cancels your policy.

mismatches.say: Dana's Bay City client has a building that's sat empty seventy days. The insurance company wants to cancel. How much warning does it owe? The twenty thirteen form allows five days' notice for certain building conditions, like sixty or more consecutive days vacant or unoccupied.
